description.narrative: Raise Your Voice Saint Lucia is an organization determined to empower women and children victims of domestic violence in Saint Lucia by providing them with the social and economic skills that are necessary to help them reach their full potential. They provide quality, compassionate and nonjudgmental services in a manner that fosters self-respect and independence, that go from legal and medical support to providing accommodation and crisis support. They also invest in preventing future incidences of violence by educating their community through the use of various strategies and play a significant role in the advocacy front, especially as it relates to policy and regulation. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries and stipends, bank fees, financial auditing and tax return, office utilities, office maintenance, office supplies, website hosting, software, staff retreat and training; - Meeting/ workshop-related costs such as transportation, facilitator and trainer fees, meals, venue rental, materials, and others, including a consultation and information session on the draft version of the Status of Children Bill; - Services to victims of gender-based violence including meals, medical and legal services, accommodation, educational support, and others; - Support to participants in agro processing facility, including child care, transportation, and others.
